initial:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: reusable isolated hero illustration for a minimalist Chinese short-video cover; typography and avatar will be composed separately with JavaScript.
Primary request: generate one beautifully simple, unmistakable 3D image-card icon with a tiny AI sparkle, using warm ivory and a restrained orange accent.
Subject: a single thick rounded photo card, warm ivory outer frame, a recessed pale apricot picture panel containing two broad clean orange mountain shapes and a tiny orange sun. One small four-point orange sparkle floats just outside the upper-right corner of the card and communicates AI image creation.
Style/medium: refined soft 3D illustration, smooth matte ceramic and clay, rounded edges, readable silhouette, restrained studio rendering.
Composition/framing: square canvas, isolated object centered, nearly front-facing with a subtle three-quarter perspective, card occupying about 72 percent of the canvas. Keep generous transparent space around all edges. All parts remain inside the canvas.
Lighting/mood: soft studio light from the upper left, subtle natural shading and a delicate contact shadow.
Color palette: warm ivory #F6F3ED, pale apricot #F9DEC8, soft orange #EC8956 and a restrained darker burnt orange #C9663F.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background. Only the image-card and its single small sparkle. Entire scene simple and calm, immediately recognizable at thumbnail size. Typography, people, logos, badges and extra decorations are excluded. No text or watermark.
revision:

Asset type: isolated hero illustration for a minimalist short-video cover.
Input image: edit target; preserve its image-card geometry, camera angle, rounded matte 3D style, ivory frame, simple mountain silhouette, small sun and single four-point sparkle.
Primary request: recolor the colored parts to the user's exact accent color #FFC712. The two mountain shapes, small sun and sparkle have base color #FFC712, with gentle physically natural lighter highlights and deeper golden shadows. The recessed picture panel is almost ivory with only a very pale cream tint. The ivory frame stays warm white.
Constraints: preserve the composition and subject exactly. Keep the background truly transparent. Clean smooth antialiased silhouette with no stray fragments or colored fringe outside the object. Include only this image-card and its existing one sparkle, no text, people, logos, badges or extra objects.
